children.game_version: A 'statue' game where children must freeze in a 'worship' pose without dropping a paper flower.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the 'worship duli' gestures and arm movements with golden flowers while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Slow walking steps without complex turns; use battery-operated candles for safety.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo; focus on upper body grace.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Carrying lit candles and 'Golden Flowers' (Bunga Mas).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced in front of dignitaries or a wedding couple; 5-8 dancers.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to medium levels; no jumps described.
movement_profile.partnering: Can be solo, odd-numbered groups, or male-female pairs.

signature_moves.description: A gesture of homage and forgiveness directed toward royalty or the wedding couple.
signature_moves.name: Worship Duli

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Graceful and deliberate to accommodate lit candles.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid sudden movements that could extinguish the candles or drop the golden flowers.

music_profile.sound_description: The music serves as a rhythmic backdrop for a ceremonial procession, likely featuring traditional Malay percussion to guide the dancers' steady movements.

basic_steps: Enter the performance space carrying lit candles and golden flowers
Perform the 'worship duli' gesture of homage toward the guests of honor
Execute slow, rhythmic steps while maintaining the balance of the candles
Form a line or circle depending on the number of dancers (5-8)
Conclude with a gesture of humility and retreat
teaching.formation: Odd numbers (5, 7) or pairs; often in a line in front of the wedding dais
teaching.level_notes: Requires significant hand-eye coordination to balance props while moving.
teaching.rhythm: Slow and steady traditional Malay beat
